title: avenula marginata subsp. albinervis
intro: Avenula marginata subsp. albinervis, commonly known as Alpine Sweet Vernal Grass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the grass family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits in relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Avenula marginata subsp. albinervis include its ability to ease congestion and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
